research_question: For the frozen E054 rolling-HHI regime score, how many winning numbers survive TOP10/15/20/25/30 before the E045 allocator is applied, and at which rank/conditional-count signal were missed winners excluded?
novelty_vs_completed_work: E054 evaluated only its final three-line union18 portfolio; its stored predictions do not report candidate_recall@K.
E051 candidate-stage diagnostics evaluated a different pair-context signal family; E059 isolates the frozen E054 candidate score without changing its allocator or weights.
This is a stage-decomposition diagnostic, not a new candidate model or a model-selection sweep.

runner.runtime: Deterministic JavaScript; same algorithm executed in Code Mode V8

frozen_candidate_model.feature: For target t, HHI of main-number counts in draws t-100..t-1; compare with median of up to 200 earlier rolling-100 HHI windows ending t-300..t-101; HIGH if current HHI >= median, otherwise LOW.
frozen_candidate_model.training_outcomes: At target t, use only outcomes u=301..t-1; each historical outcome u is assigned its regime using information through u-1.

candidate_evaluation.metric: candidate_recall@K = mean over targets of (winning main numbers among the top K candidates / 6)
candidate_evaluation.exact_random_baseline: Uniform K-subset of 1..45; expected hits=6*K/45 and expected recall=K/45 for every target.
candidate_evaluation.stable_baseline: recent30: frequency of each number in the 30 main-number draws immediately before target t; rank descending frequency, then number ascending.
candidate_evaluation.trace: One row for each of the six winning numbers at each target (5100 rows), including E054 rank/score, regime success count/exposure, recent30 rank/count, first K captured, and score gap to each K cutoff.

inference.primary_comparisons: Five E054 candidate_recall@K differences versus exact random expectation.
inference.secondary_comparisons: Five paired E054 versus recent30 candidate_recall@K differences.
inference.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target recall differences; 17 blocks of 50 targets sampled with replacement, every valid contiguous block start equally likely.

reproduction_checks: Rebuild all 850 E054 target regimes and compare HIGH/LOW, current HHI, threshold HHI, reference-window count, and regime training exposure to the frozen E054 PREDICTIONS.csv.
Rebuild all 45 E054 scores per target and compare score_sha256 to the frozen E054 prediction record; require 850/850 matches for exact score reproduction.

historical_contamination.rounds_1244_1249: Already inspected/live-history material; not a clean holdout and not prospective confirmation.

reporting.strict_candidate_threshold: Not specified by current policy; do not invent one.
